subject: [PATCH bpf-next v3 4/4] selftests/bpf: Add preemption recursion test for tracing programs

reviews.author: Mike Bazov
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that tracing programs entering through __bpf_prog_enter_recur() have a different code path than those entering through fentry, and suggested adding two more rows to the existing code for consistency.
reviews.raw_body:
They enter through the same __bpf_prog_enter_recur() as fentry, but it
is two rows each, so adding them is minor.

2026-11-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a preemption recursion test to the BPF selftests for tracing programs, ensuring that the kernel's preemption mechanism functions correctly in such scenarios.
